comparisons.name: element-selected-light
comparisons.description: The month selected with Tab in the key window: the selection colour behind it and the focus ring around the field. Aqua.

pixels.note: selection colour in the corner of the month, above its digits: measured on the selected day of the calendar (spec: #0362e1); that a selected element takes it is inferred
fill of the field beside the selection (spec: Textual field fill, measured)
focus ring over the window background, 1 pt outside the field's edge, measured on the Go to Folder field (spec: focus-ring)
window background outside the ring, which ends 2.5 pt beyond the edge

comparisons.name: element-selected-dark
comparisons.description: The month selected with Tab in the key window, Dark Aqua.

pixels.note: selection colour, measured on the selected day of the dark calendar (spec: #0057cf); inferred for an element
fill of the field (spec: Textual field fill, dark, measured)
focus ring over the #2f3032 window background, measured in Automator (spec: focus-ring)
window background outside the ring

comparisons.name: element-selected-inactive
comparisons.description: The month selected with Tab in an inactive window: the unemphasised selection and no focus ring. Aqua.

pixels.note: unemphasised selection (--mac-color-selected-content-background-unemphasized, measured in Keychain Access); inferred for an element
window background where the ring would be: AppKit removes the ring when the window is not key (spec: focus-ring, States, documented)

comparisons.name: element-selected-main
comparisons.description: The month selected with Tab in a main window that is not key: as in an inactive window. Aqua.

pixels.note: unemphasised selection; inferred
no focus ring (spec: focus-ring, States, documented)

comparisons.name: stepper-selects-light
comparisons.description: A click on the stepper while nothing is selected: the first element, the month, is selected and takes the keyboard. Aqua.

pixels.note: selection colour in the corner of the month; that the stepper selects the first element is inferred from AppKit's behaviour
focus ring: the element has the keyboard

window background below the regular field

fill of the small field 1.5 pt above its bottom edge (height inferred, 20 pt)
window background below the small field
fill of the mini field 3 pt above its bottom edge at y 84
fill of the mini field 1.5 pt above its bottom edge (height inferred, 17 pt)
window background below the mini field

comparisons.name: calendar-enabled-light
comparisons.description: The enabled calendar in the key window, 3 October 2019 selected, nothing focused. Aqua.

pixels.note: selected day, left of its digit (spec: Calendar selected day, sRGB #0362e1, measured on the disabled calendar)
background between the first two rows (spec: Calendar background, measured)
centre of the today disc: secondary label colour, black at 50% on white (spec: navigation glyphs, enabled, inferred)
no focus ring while nothing in the calendar has the keyboard

comparisons.name: calendar-enabled-dark
comparisons.description: The enabled calendar in the key window, Dark Aqua.

pixels.note: selected day (spec: Calendar selected day, dark, sRGB #0057cf, measured)
background of the enabled calendar: the field's fill, inferred (the disabled one measures #232323)
centre of the today disc: secondary label colour, white at 55% on #2a2a2a (inferred)

comparisons.name: calendar-day-focus-light
comparisons.description: The selected day focused with Tab (after the three buttons): the focus ring is around the calendar. Aqua.

pixels.note: focus ring over the window background, 1 pt outside the calendar's edge (spec: focus-ring; that the calendar draws it is inferred)
the focused day is the selected one

comparisons.name: calendar-next-month-light
comparisons.description: Page Down on the focused day: the selection moves to 3 November, in the second row and first column of the next month. Aqua.

pixels.note: selected day, 3 November 2019, a Sunday in the second row (selection colour measured; the key is the WAI-ARIA date grid's)
background where 3 October was selected
the new day keeps the keyboard: the focus ring stays

comparisons.name: calendar-button-focus-light
comparisons.description: The previous month button focused with Tab: a ring inside the button's box. Aqua.

pixels.note: the focus ring colour at 50% over the white background, in the 2 pt band inside the button's left edge at x 101.125 (inferred: AppKit does not focus the glyphs separately)
the today disc beside it is unchanged

comparisons.name: calendar-inactive-light
comparisons.description: The enabled calendar in an inactive window: the unemphasised selection. Aqua.

pixels.note: unemphasised selection (measured in Keychain Access); inferred for the calendar
